parsed.main_gap: Step 2 uses the false assertion that a non-increasing positive integer starting above 1 cannot reach 1; thus survival of a nonunit is not proved as written.

errors.description: The stated monotonicity argument is invalid: a non-increasing positive integer can decrease from above 1 to 1. A separate argument is required to show that each move leaves at least one selected output greater than 1.
errors.quote: A positive integer that never increases and starts above $1$ can never reach $1$; hence $P > 1$ after any number of moves.

errors.description: The final exponential-divisibility characterization is false without restricting to primes occurring initially: for an absent prime, every positive exponent divides all zero valuations, so arbitrary new prime factors satisfy the stated condition and no maximal $d$ exists.
errors.quote: the unique maximal $d$ with $v_p(d) \mid v_p(a_i)$ for all $p$ and all $i$.

parsed.notes: The termination argument and valuation-gcd invariant correctly establish the central result apart from the small, readily repairable survival gap. The second issue occurs only in a concluding remark and does not affect the boxed formula.
